text:
Sam R: FYI postmortem follow-up from the midnight flurry. posting concise action items so they land in the board.
Lee P: saw noisy alert floods from the same shard hitting three escalation groups. dedupe logic didn't group them.
Dana H: root cause sketch: transient overload + aggressive paging threshold + per-region dedupe of 20s. duplicates came from traffic burst across regions.
Sam R: propose concrete tasks: 1) raise paging threshold for shard-memory-pressure from 65% -> 78% (owner: Lee P, ETA: 48h); 2) make dedupe window region-aware and extend global window to 3m (owner: Victor M, ETA: 72h); 3) add suppression candidate job that tags alerts firing >=6 times in 24h for manual review (owner: Dana H, ETA: 10 days).
Victor M: ack. for (2) I'll add a cross-region fingerprint key: cluster+shard+error_hash and bump window. putting a feature flag so we can rollback quickly. sample config:
```yaml
dedupe:
  window_seconds: 180
  keys: [cluster, shard, error_hash]
```
Lee P: ack. for (1) will open alerts PR and include a brief runbook with simulated traffic steps. also adding a 3m cooldown so we don't get flappy re-pages.
Dana H: for the suppression job I'll write a small cron job that exports candidates to the "alerts-review" channel and creates a card in the postmortem board. will only auto-suppress if reviewed.
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT-5203 cleared. Please attach follow-up owners to the incident.
Sam R: optional safety item: add a canary suppression rollout (10% of alerts suppressed first 24h) to ensure we don't hide regressions. owner: Victor M, ETA: 2w.
Lee P: good call. also recommend adding a short-lived metric "duplicate_alert_rate" to the dashboard so we can watch suppression impact. owner: Lee P, ETA: 1w.
Victor M: created branch: https://git.redwood/routing/branch/dedupe-region-aware-3m. will add tests to assert identical root_cause hashes group across regions.
Dana H: suppression job PR: https://git.redwood/alerts/pull/998. includes crontab + export to the reviews board.
Lee P: alert tweak PR: https://git.redwood/alerts/pull/1001  includes threshold bump and cooldown.
Sam R: thanks all. I'll slot a quick 15m sync in 48h to check progress and mark owners in the postmortem board. close thread when PRs merged and card created. :white_check_mark:
Victor M: noted. will coordinate rollback plan in the PR description.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: weekly alert-cleanup sweep scheduled (Fridays 09:00 UTC).
Sam R: great, closing for now. ping if anything urgent pops up.
